text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian puts on a demonic 
performance, completely unlike her last 
race. Even so, Biko Pegasus refuses to 
give up 1st place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Through an all-out, blazing clash with 
Biko Pegasus, Narita Brian rekindled her 
fighting spirit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, Biko Pegasus learned 
that the action actor was moving to the 
US. Vowing to both become even greater 
heroes, she saw the actor off.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The next target is the Yasuda Kinen. Hishi 
Akebono vents that she wanted to enter 
too, but without a maiden win, she cannot 
participate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biko Pegasus cheered Hishi Akebono up with 
Carrotman's signature catchphrase: "We're 
just getting started!"
